title: Add encoder capability dump diagnostic
summary: Add a read-only encoder capability report diagnostic for the resolved primary and CPU-fallback descriptors, exposed through a lockless MediaPipeline.ps1 dump switch.
reason: Phase 6 needs descriptor-backed capability evidence available before hardware-family activation and later Python/UI capability annotations.
behavior_before: Descriptor capability probes existed only as in-memory helper results and the entrypoint had no read-only dump mode for resolved encoder capability evidence.
behavior_after: New-MediaEncoderCapabilityReport builds JSON-ready capability evidence for resolved primary/fallback descriptors, Write-MediaEncoderCapabilityReport writes it to the requested path, and MediaPipeline.ps1 -DumpEncoderCapabilitiesPath emits the report without taking the singleton lock or rewriting shared worker state.
manual_validation: PowerShell parser check for encoder_descriptors.ps1, MediaPipeline.ps1, startup_filesystem.ps1, and Invoke-RuntimeConfigResolutionChecks.ps1 - passed
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-EncoderRuntimeMatrixChecks.ps1 - passed (3 CPU rows executed, 9 hardware rows list-only skipped by default)
rollback_plan: Remove New-MediaEncoderCapabilityReport and Write-MediaEncoderCapabilityReport, remove -DumpEncoderCapabilitiesPath and lockless-diagnostic guard changes, remove the runtime config diagnostic test scenario, revert docs/inventory wording, and refresh generated summaries.
